title: agent.md frontmatter
description: The settings of one agent in a factory tree. The folder name is the agent name. The body of the file is the prompt. This schema checks the YAML frontmatter of agents/<name>/agent.md.

role.description: The stage that the agent runs. At most 1 agent in a tree is the foreman.

description.description: One line that says when to use this agent.

harness.description: The agent CLI that runs the agent.

runner.description: The name of a file in runners/, without .yaml. A lowercase kebab-case name.
